audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer describes the PRE-REWORK Aurelion Sol. It names 'Starsurge' (whys[1], spikes[0], spikes[2], early, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1]) and 'Voice of Light' (whys[4], spikes[1], mid, wants.foe[2]) — neither ability exists — and it calls Singularity his Q when it is his E.
audit.why: The kit file is authoritative: P Cosmic Creator, Q Breath of Light, W Astral Flight, E Singularity, R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. Every one of those fields sends a paying reader looking for a spell that is not on the champion.
audit.corrected: Starsurge -> Falling Star (R), Voice of Light -> Falling Star, Singularity relabelled (E) throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions that decide this lane were absent. (a) Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both CHANNELS — Ekko's Parallel Convergence stun cancels either one outright, and cancelling the flight strands him. (b) Singularity executes enemies below a health percentage — the threshold, not the bar, is what you track. (c) Singularity grants Stardust for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it, and Stardust permanently improves every one of his abilities, so farming inside the black hole pays him forever.
audit.why: All three are in Riot's own text and all three are in this matchup's missingInteractions list.
audit.corrected: Written into winCon, enemyWin, tradeGood, tradeBad, report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.wave, dontsFull[2], phases[0..2].why, whys[1], early and mid.

edits.after: Aurelion Sol is slow to ramp and has zero mobility at level 1-2, so bully him with the dash before Singularity (E) is big enough to zone you out — Breath of Light is a channel, and simply stepping out of it ends the damage. edits.before: Voice of Light adds real poke range at level 6, but it doesn't give him any way to disengage — he's still rooted in place if you commit past his zone, so your all-in potential remains strong through this window as long as you dodge or bait his Starsurge stun first. This stays one of your more comfortable matchups into the mid-game.
edits.after: Falling Star adds a 1250-range stun at level 6, but it costs 120s and gives him no way to disengage — he is still rooted in place if you commit past his zone, so your all-in stays strong through this window as long as you bait the stun first. Better still, hold W for a channel: Breath of Light and Astral Flight both die to a stun, and cancelling the flight strands him exactly where you want him.

Neither ability exists on the champion. Singularity was also labelled (Q) when it is his E.
